usedFor: ZenCommerce holds orders and customers, and Calendly gives each a booking link through “Create Scheduling Link”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Customer” in ZenCommerce, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A new customer can book an onboarding call, so a link is ready to send them.

watchOut: “Customer Updated” and “Order Updated” fire on every change, so they would create a new link each time.
